mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SEARCH_HISTORY ( USER_ID, CONTENT_ID, CONTENT_TYPE_ID, SPOT_NAME, ADDRESS, L_DONG_REGN_CD, L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD, LC_LS_SYSTM1, LC_LS_SYSTM2, LC_LS_SYSTM3, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, THUMBNAIL, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{contentId}, #{contentTypeId}, #{spotName}, #{address}, #{lDongRegnCd}, #{lDongSignguCd}, #{lclsSystm1}, #{lclsSystm2}, #{lclsSystm3}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{thumbnail}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE SEARCH_HISTORY SET CONTENT_TYPE_ID = #{contentTypeId}, SPOT_NAME = #{spotName}, ADDRESS = #{address}, L_DONG_REGN_CD = #{lDongRegnCd}, L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD = #{lDongSignguCd}, LC_LS_SYSTM1 = #{lclsSystm1}, LC_LS_SYSTM2 = #{lclsSystm2}, LC_LS_SYSTM3 = #{lclsSystm3}, LATITUDE = #{latitude}, LONGITUDE = #{longitude}, THUMBNAIL = #{thumbnail}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC, HISTORY_ID DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT SH.HISTORY_ID AS historyId, SH.CONTENT_ID AS contentId, SH.CONTENT_TYPE_ID AS contentTypeId, SH.SPOT_NAME AS spotName, SH.ADDRESS AS address, SH.THUMBNAIL AS thumbnail, SH.LC_LS_SYSTM1 AS lclsSystm1, SH.LC_LS_SYSTM2 AS lclsSystm2, SH.LC_LS_SYSTM3 AS lclsSystm3, SH.UPDATED_AT AS createdAt FROM SEARCH_HISTORY SH WHERE SH.USER_ID = #{userId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SEARCH_HISTORY SH2 WHERE SH2.USER_ID = SH.USER_ID AND SH2.CONTENT_ID = SH.CONTENT_ID AND ( SH2.UPDATED_AT > SH.UPDATED_AT OR ( SH2.UPDATED_AT = SH.UPDATED_AT AND SH2.HISTORY_ID > SH.HISTORY_ID ) ) ) ORDER BY SH.UPDATED_AT DESC, SH.HISTORY_ID DESC LIMIT 10
